title: MAS1 v6 canonical task-instance finding ledger
description: Normative structural schema. The MAS1 v6 prompt supplies append-only and cross-reference procedural integrity requirements.

transformation.original_content_preservation: All original members, collection rows, array order, object key presence, scalar types, and marker fields remain byte-for-byte in the preserved prefix.

receipt.binding: identity-and-path-only; target payloads do not contain a receipt digest

threshold_evidence.original_provider_timestamp_unavailable_: The completed Astra finding arrived without a provider timestamp in the available task evidence.
threshold_evidence.original_discovery_at_unavailable_reason: The original second-escape discovery time is unavailable in the task evidence.
threshold_evidence.first_threshold_known_at_unavailable_rea: The first moment the second-escape threshold became known is unavailable and is not inferred from administrative or migration timestamps.
threshold_evidence.threshold_evidence_received_at_semantics: Local receipt of the already-completed second-escape finding before compatibility implementation; a conservative auditable upper bound, not the unavailable original discovery, provider, authorization, decision-recording, migration-selection, or apply time.
